mapper.select:
SELECT p.id, p.title, p.price, p.cover, p.view_count, p.create_time, u.nickname AS sellerName FROM product p JOIN user u ON u.id = p.user_id WHERE p.deleted = 0 AND p.status = 1
AND p.category_id = #{categoryId}
AND p.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
ORDER BY p.price ASC ORDER BY p.price DESC ORDER BY p.view_count DESC ORDER BY p.create_time DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE product SET stock = stock - 1, status = 3, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 1 AND stock > 0
UPDATE product SET stock = stock + 1, status = 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
